text:
West Maui residents offered free bulky item recycling at Go Green event July 18
U. N. Kim
West Maui residents may dispose of recyclable, bulky items for free at the Go Green Recycling event scheduled from 8 a.m. to noon on July 18 at 300 Lahainaluna Road near the Pioneer Mill smokestack, with entry off Kuhua Street.
The event requires drop-off appointments, which can be requested online. It is hosted by nonprofit Mālama Maui Nui in partnership with the County of Maui Department of Environmental Management Environmental Protection & Sustainability Division and the Abandoned Vehicles and Metals Section. Only residential drop-offs will be accepted; commercial drop-offs are not permitted.
Recyclable items accepted include air conditioners, lead acid batteries, washers and dryers, dishwashers, microwaves, refrigerators, stoves, water heaters, tires, scrap metals, and various electronics such as TVs, computers, printers, copiers, and monitors along with associated electrical cords.
Adults are being sought for one-hour volunteer shifts during the event. Volunteers will receive access to a water bottle refill cooler as well as snacks and personal protective equipment. Registration details for volunteers are available online.
For more information about future Go Green Recycling events or questions regarding locations, directions, accepted recyclables, and appointments, residents can contact Mālama Maui Nui at (808) 877-2524 or County DEM Abandoned Vehicles and Metals Section at (808) 270-6102.
